question: How is the five-fold self revealed through immersion in the nature of the void-wheel?
premises: There is immersion in the nature of the void-wheel.
A five-fold self is the subject of revelation.
This revelation occurs following that immersion.
inference: Immersion in the void-wheel reveals the five-fold self.
uncertainties: The internal sandhi in tayonmagnaḥ is noted but the token is kept fused as given.
plain_english: Then, immersed in the nature of the void-wheel, the five-fold self was revealed.
